title: Phase VII model freeze: FORTIS-R Joint and comparators, before the EGAD confirmation
status: frozen before any confirmatory object was planned

final_method.name: FORTIS-R Joint
final_method.order: p~ * P(H|F) * max(Q_cen, 1e-3)^0.3, planner stroke gate first
final_method.physical_criterion: v3: rise >= 80 mm, slip < 20 mm, rotation from the grip <= 15 deg, contact kept; torsion 0.005 m; nine conditions
final_method.configuration: demo cell, 80 mm parallel gripper, part at (0.42, 0, 0.42), assumed mass 0.1 kg

hyperparameters.beta_joint_rule: protocol I.4 criterion on all 151 development parts (out-of-fold P(H|F)); also the value chosen in 4 of 5 outer folds

methods.M0: original planner order (preliminary score, makeable first)
methods.Joint: p~ * P(H|F) * max(Q_cen, 1e-3)^0.3 (fusion order) -- FORTIS-R Joint, final method
methods.hybrid: round robin of Joint and M0 (secondary)

normalisation: p~ = P(F)/max over the object; Q_cen = minmax(clip(1 - centre_offset/finger_depth, 0, 1)); MLP inputs standardised with training-set statistics stored in each .pt file

p_robust_given_feasible.label: Phase VI v2 robust in the six standard conditions
